newsitem.title: USA: Hertz Technology names Robert Cohen CFO.
newsitem.headline: Hertz Technology names Robert Cohen CFO.

text.p: Hertz Technology Group Inc said Monday it has appointed Robert Cohen as chief financial officer.
Before his appointment, Cohen was for five years corporate controller of Merlite Industries Inc, a New York-based direct marketing company, Hertz Technology said.
A company spokeswoman said Cohen is replacing John Rudy.
Hertz Technology sells microcomputers and related technology support and services and makes ergonomically engineered mounting and support structures for personal computers and related equipment.
The company went public in November.
